notes.title: Have You Played Majesty?
notes.notes:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives. One a day, every day of the year, perhaps for all time.

I didn’t love Majesty [official site] as much as I loved the concept of Majesty, which is probably why I’ve been waiting for a(nother) sequel for so long. A new version, done properly, could well be one of my favourite games. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Now Available - Defenders of Ardania
notes.notes:
Defenders of Ardania is now available on Steam!

Defenders of Ardania is a next-generation tower defense game set in the rich fantasy world of Majesty, but with a twist. In addition to the addictive core mechanics of placing towers to stop advancing enemy units, DoA also allows players to take on the role of the attackers seeking to conquer the enemy base in both single and multiplayer combat!

To celebrate the launch of Defenders of Ardania, the Majesty 2 series is on sale at 75% off until Thursday, March 15th at 10AM Pacific time!

notes.title: Now Available - Majesty 2 Collection
notes.notes:
The Majesty 2 Collection is now available on Steam!

This Collection brings together all Majesty 2 content including the original fantasy kingdom Sim and all available expansions: Kingmaker, Battles of Ardania, and Monster Kingdom.

Purchase before April 26th at 10AM and receive a free copy of Majesty: Gold Edition!
